title: Grade Boundaries — MathsGenie style parity: pills, graded meter endpoints, mean-row Average, fitted table, hue-ramped graph
origin: Operator word this trace: "Still it is not in the style of MathsGenie. Did you check them out visually?" — T-GRADE-3 proved value parity (G2 6/6 byte-identical) and T-GRADE-003 run-002 cloned MG's saved page DOM, but no run had ever compared the two LIVE pages. This run did: MG's live predicted-grade-calculator (IGCSE Chemistry Edexcel) screenshotted in table view, graph view and a selected-session state.
deltas: pills: active = bordered background chip (--foreground ring, --background fill) with a leading check dot (lucide Check in a filled circle); inactive = borderless muted — replaces the filled accent pill
grade rail: caption is MG's marks-to-next affordance ('↑ 26 marks to 1' on the live corpus; '↑ N UMS to G' on the aggregate rail); static 'Most likely grade'/'Predicted — X' captions retired

meter: graded endpoints 'G · mark … next · boundary' (e.g. 'U · 0 … 1 · 26' linear; 'U · 0 … E · 240' aggregate cash-in) replace the bare '0 / Max' scale; the A*-rule shortfall demoted to the muted footnote line

Average semantics: MG's per-grade MEAN boundary row (averageBoundariesAcrossSeries — mean per grade over sessions carrying it, rounded half-up, null preserved for never-published grades) drives both the linear and the aggregate average mode (mean of eligible sessions' cash-in boundaries; per-session raw→UMS conversions unchanged); modalGradeAcrossSeries retired from the component but kept as a tested calc-lib utility
linear table: Max column dropped — MG fits ten columns in the max-w-3xl card, ours clipped at 1280px; papers labels + R badge + tier column, grouping rowSpan and the honest footnote untouched

graph: MG's dark-green→red per-grade hue ramp (gradeRampColor, interpolated per ladder position) with ringed dots (white fill, colored ring, r=4) replaces the 5-token cycle that collided on 9-grade ladders
